resources.string: Select text with the pen button
Select messages by dragging on the background
Click with the button while hovering

Hold the pen button to select text or drag beside message bubbles. Double-tap the same message with the button held to select its text. While hovering, press and release the button to tap at the pen position. Requires compatible stylus input; Bluetooth Air Actions are not supported. Protected text cannot be selected. Disabled by default. Disable the original plugin if installed. Based on S-Pen Support 1.6.0 by @huecoder.
